thesis: Regime holds: memory/HBM stays the binding constraint, confirmed again by compute-layer momentum (MRVL +183.9%, AMD +149.8%, MU +134.8%). Power (PWR, GEV, ETN) and infrastructure (CSCO, VRT) momentum remain strong on GW-scale cluster buildout, no new catalyst since the last three updates. Watch item, not yet actionable: Stratechery flags Nvidia tapping long-duration debt/equity financing to bridge
